released_problem_variant: <str, fixed='relief_point_completion_v1'> Must match the executable instance contract.
objective_value: <float> Total cost of the rescheduling plan, combining the cost of the selected completions for all original duties and the penalty for all canceled tasks.
canceled_tasks: <list[str]> Identifiers of the unfinished tasks that are canceled rather than covered by any driver.

<duty_id>.completion_index: <int> Index of the feasible completion selected for this original duty among the enumerated completions.
<duty_id>.cost: <float> Exact released completion cost: fixed change cost plus task-reassignment, new-transfer, and taxi costs (zero only for an unchanged completion).
<duty_id>.covered_tasks: <list[str]> Ordered identifiers of tasks operated by the duty.
<duty_id>.uses_taxi: <bool> Exact taxi-use flag derived from the route connections and return.
<duty_id>.release_at_relief_point: <bool> True only when the frozen horizon provides no timely base return and the driver is released at the final relief point.
<duty_id>.return_station: <str> Station reached at the end of the released completion.
<duty_id>.return_time_minutes: <int> Derived end/return time in minutes from midnight.
